# The change is proportionate to the problem

Coding rule · `S5.8`

The change is proportionate to the problem. Before handing over, re-read the diff: no abstraction for a single use, no configurability nobody asked for, no error handling for states that cannot occur. If it is much larger than the problem, rewrite it smaller first.

Part of [[Hubs/Coding rules|Coding rules]].
